turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We want a regular game night with the neighbours but can't agree how often or where.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could rotate houses every other Friday, so everyone hosts and nobody gets stuck cleaning up every time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or always do it at ours, since we have the biggest table, and the others bring food.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A third idea is meeting monthly at the pub on the corner, which has a back room and lends games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Rotating keeps it fair and everyone feels involved, but it can fizzle if one house is tiny. Hosting at yours is easiest to keep going. The pub is relaxed, though monthly might feel too rare to build a habit.
